title: Exploring Cultural Variations in Moral Judgments with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Correlating model-derived moral justifiability scores—obtained via log-probability differences or direct numerical ratings on template-based prompts—with country-level human survey data from the World Values Survey (WVS) and Pew Global Attitudes Survey to detect alignment with Western-centric (W.E.I.R.D.) versus non-W.E.I.R.D. moral norms.
